L1_Desc: End-to-end process of aligning supply and demand to support business objectives through cross-functional planning cycles.
L2_Desc: Processes to capture, analyze and shape customer demand signals to produce an unconstrained demand plan.
L3_Desc: Use of statistical models to generate a baseline demand forecast from historical data.
L4_Desc: Run statistical forecasting algorithms on historical sales data to produce an item-level baseline forecast for the planning horizon.
Input: 2-3 years historical sales data, seasonality indices, promotional calendar
Tool_navigation: IBP > Demand > Statistical Forecast > Run Forecast Job
Tool_desc: SAP IBP uses algorithms (Holt-Winters, ARIMA, MLR) to auto-select best fit model per item.

L4_Desc: Demand planners review system-generated forecast, apply market intelligence, and override where justified. All overrides must be documented with rationale.
Input: Baseline forecast, market intelligence, account team inputs, promotional plans
Output: Adjusted consensus demand forecast with override log
Goal: OVA > 0 — overrides improve accuracy vs baseline
Tool_navigation: IBP > Demand > Planner Workbench > Override & Notes
Tool_desc: Planners adjust quantities in the planner workbench; reason codes and comments are mandatory.

L3_Desc: Cross-functional review of the demand forecast to produce an agreed, unconstrained demand plan.
L4_Desc: Facilitate the monthly Demand Review meeting with Sales, Marketing, and Planning to challenge assumptions, align on the demand plan, and escalate key risks.
Input: Adjusted forecast, market intelligence deck, YTD actuals vs plan, risk & opportunity register
Output: Approved unconstrained demand plan, escalation items for S&OP, meeting minutes
KPI: Forecast version lock rate, meeting attendance ≥ 90%
Goal: Agreed plan locked by Day 4 of planning cycle
Tool_navigation: IBP > Demand > Review Dashboard; SharePoint > S&OP > Demand Review
Tool_desc: Standard agenda and pre-read distributed 24h in advance. Decisions logged in meeting minutes template.

L2_Desc: Processes to translate the unconstrained demand plan into a feasible supply plan considering capacity, inventory, and procurement constraints.
L3_Desc: Assess whether manufacturing and supply capacity is sufficient to meet the demand plan.
L4_Desc: Execute Rough-Cut Capacity Planning to identify capacity gaps or surpluses versus the agreed demand plan across all critical resources.
Input: Approved demand plan, bill of resources, available capacity calendar, open production orders
Output: RCCP output: capacity load profile, gap analysis, recommended actions
KPI: Capacity utilization %, number of unconstrained gaps
Goal: All critical resource gaps identified and actioned before Supply Review
Tool_navigation: IBP > Supply > Capacity Planning > Run RCCP
Tool_desc: System maps demand plan to resources using bill of resources; outputs load vs capacity chart per work center.

L4_Desc: Analyze RCCP output to develop feasible supply scenarios (e.g., overtime, outsourcing, demand shaping) and present recommendations to resolve identified capacity gaps.
Input: RCCP gap analysis, cost of alternatives, lead times, inventory levels
Output: Scenario analysis with P&L impact, recommended supply response options
KPI: Time to develop scenarios (target ≤ 1 business day), scenario coverage
Goal: At least 2 feasible options presented per significant gap
Tool_navigation: IBP > Supply > Scenario Manager; SharePoint > S&OP > Capacity Templates
Tool_desc: Planners model what-if scenarios in IBP Scenario Manager; financial impact modeled in Excel template.

L3_Desc: Cross-functional meeting to align on the constrained supply plan and resolve capacity issues before the pre-S&OP.
L4_Desc: Facilitate the monthly Supply Review meeting with Manufacturing, Procurement, and Supply Planning to agree on the constrained supply plan and escalate unresolved gaps.
Input: RCCP output, capacity scenarios, inventory plan, procurement constraints
Output: Agreed constrained supply plan, escalation items for pre-S&OP, meeting minutes
KPI: Supply plan lock rate, gap resolution rate before pre-S&OP
Goal: ≥ 85% of gaps resolved at Supply Review; remainder escalated with recommended options
Tool_navigation: IBP > Supply > Review Dashboard; SharePoint > S&OP > Supply Review
Tool_desc: Standard agenda covers RCCP, inventory, procurement risks, and constrained plan vs demand.

L4: Translate Supply Plan to Financial View
L2_Desc: Processes to translate operational plans into financial terms and ensure alignment with the annual operating plan (AOP) and rolling forecast.
L3_Desc: Convert volume-based demand and supply plans into revenue, COGS, and margin projections.
L4_Desc: Finance translates the agreed volume plan into a P&L projection (revenue, standard COGS, gross margin) and compares to AOP and latest estimate for gap identification.
Supplier: Constrained supply plan, standard cost file, pricing master
Input: Agreed volume plan (demand & supply), standard cost rates, transfer prices, revenue pricing
Output: Financial S&OP plan (P&L view): revenue, COGS, gross margin vs AOP and LE
KPI: Gap to AOP (revenue & margin), plan conversion time
Goal: Financial plan completed within 1 business day of supply plan lock
Tool_navigation: Anaplan > S&OP Module > Financial Translation Worksheet
Tool_desc: Anaplan pulls volume plan automatically; analyst validates pricing and cost assumptions before publishing.

L2_Desc: Senior leadership review and decision-making process to resolve cross-functional trade-offs and set business direction.
L3_Desc: Middle management preparation meeting to consolidate inputs, resolve solvable issues, and define agenda for Executive S&OP.
L4_Desc: Cross-functional managers review the integrated demand, supply, and financial plans, resolve issues within their authority, and prepare the Executive S&OP package.
Supplier: Demand Review, Supply Review, Financial Integration outputs
Input: Demand plan, constrained supply plan, financial P&L view, open risks & opportunities, prior month KPI scorecard
Output: Pre-read package for Executive S&OP, resolved issues log, escalation items with recommended decisions
KPI: % issues resolved at pre-S&OP (target ≥ 70%), pre-read published ≥ 48h before Exec meeting
Goal: Executive S&OP focused on strategic decisions, not operational fire-fighting
Tool_desc: Standard pre-read template published to SharePoint; action log maintained in Teams channel.

L3_Desc: Monthly senior leadership forum to make cross-functional decisions, approve the business plan, and set priorities.
L4_Desc: Facilitate the Executive S&OP meeting where senior leaders review KPIs, make trade-off decisions (volume vs margin, service vs cost), and approve the rolling business plan.
Input: Integrated business plan, P&L gap analysis, escalated decisions, KPI scorecard, strategic risks
Output: Approved rolling plan, executive decisions log, strategic directives, published meeting minutes
KPI: Decision rate (% of items on agenda resolved), plan approval cycle time
Goal: 100% of agenda items result in a decision or owner-assigned action; minutes published within 24h
Documentation: Executive S&OP Charter v1.0, Meeting Minutes Template
Tool_navigation: SharePoint > S&OP > Executive S&OP > Current Month
Tool_desc: COO chairs; S&OP Manager facilitates. 60-min structured agenda. Decisions documented live.

L4_Desc: After Executive S&OP, distribute approved plan, decisions, and action items to all relevant stakeholders. Update planning systems with approved volumes.
Input: Approved plan decisions, action log, meeting minutes
Output: Published meeting minutes, system-updated approved plan, action log distributed to owners
Tool: SharePoint, SAP IBP, MS Teams / Email
KPI: Time to publish minutes (target ≤ 24h), action log completion rate from prior month
Goal: Approved plan uploaded to IBP within 1 business day; minutes distributed same day
Tool_navigation: IBP > Supply > Approve Plan; SharePoint > S&OP > Minutes Archive
Tool_desc: S&OP Manager activates approved version in IBP; minutes and action log emailed and posted to Teams.

L2_Desc: Processes to measure, monitor, and improve S&OP process performance and outcomes.
L3_Desc: Monthly measurement and reporting of S&OP process and outcome KPIs.
L4_Desc: Compile, validate, and publish the monthly S&OP KPI scorecard covering forecast accuracy, service levels, inventory, and process compliance metrics.
Supplier: ERP, IBP, WMS, TMS data feeds
Input: Actual sales, forecast data, inventory snapshots, order fill rates, prior cycle action log
Output: Monthly KPI scorecard (dashboard), trend analysis, red-flag commentary
KPI: Forecast Accuracy (MAPE/Bias), On-Time In-Full (OTIF), Inventory DOS, Capacity Utilization, Action Closure Rate
Goal: Scorecard published by Day 2 of each planning cycle; all KPIs trended over 13 months
Tool_navigation: Power BI > S&OP Workspace > KPI Scorecard
Tool_desc: Automated Power BI dashboard refreshes overnight from IBP/ERP; analyst validates and adds commentary.
